item.title: Daily Minute — September 23, 2026
item.description: All things are lessons God would have you learn. He would not leave an unforgiving thought without correction, nor one thorn or nail to hurt His sacred Son in any way. He would ensure his holy rest remain untroubled and serene, without a care in an eternal home which cares for him. And He would have all tears be wiped away, with none remaining yet unshed, and none but waiting their appointed time

item.title: Lesson 98: “I will accept my part in God’s plan for salvation.”
item.description: “I will accept my part in God’s plan for salvation.” Today is a day of special dedication.We take a stand on but one side today. We side with truth and let illusions go. We will not vacillate between the two, but take a firm position with the One.We dedicate ourselves to truth today, and to salvation as God planned it be. We will not argue it is something else, we will not seek for it where it is
